mezz_config.config.fileWatcher.changeSet: Milliseconds to wait after the last filesystem event before reloading changed config files.
mezz_config.config.fileWatcher.descripti: Controls automatic config file watching and reload timing.
mezz_config.config.fileWatcher.enabled.d: Automatically watch config files and reload them when they are changed outside the game.
mezz_config.config.fileWatcher.missingDi: Milliseconds between attempts to start watching config directories that do not exist yet.
mezz_config.config.logging.logUntranslat: Log category and value localization keys that are missing from the active language. Enabled by default in development environments.
mezz_config.config.name: Name: %s
mezz_config.config.requiresGameRestart: Requires a game restart to take effect.
mezz_config.config.requiresWorldRestart: Requires a world restart to take effect.
